overview.zh-Hans: 该模块用于在阿里云 Stack 上创建日志服务(SLS)项目、日志库、机器组、Logtail配置及索引，支持完整的日志采集和分析功能。
overview.en-US: This module is used to create Log Service (SLS) projects, log stores, machine groups, Logtail configurations and indexes on Alibaba Cloud Stack, supporting complete log collection and analysis capabilities.

description.zh-Hans: 用于创建SLS项目、日志库、机器组、Logtail配置和索引的Terraform模块
description.en-US: Terraform module for creating SLS projects, log stores, machine groups, Logtail configurations and indexes
